visual_findings.scene: Five-shot montage: Hon Dolo and Darth Vader at a lavish dining table; Hon Dolo reaction across Vader's shoulder; white-fur-clad lead lowering in a vapor-filled chamber; orange-lit pool close-up; finished carbonite slab.
motion_observed_in_samples: Changing mouth/head expressions while holding a wineglass in the dinner two-shot
Changing reaction expressions and head angle in the dinner close-up
Lead appears progressively lower relative to the chamber rim in later samples
Orange surface rises relative to shoulders in pool close-ups
Slab framing changes in the last shot; continuous motion has not been played back

design_evidence_frames.finding: Eye and know cheek words, retained dice above image-right eyebrow, nose/lip/ear jewelry, image-right neck mark and a ship motif high on the chest. Upper incisors appear natural with gold at the canines and metallic lower teeth in this sample.

Two human hands rest on the white-fur shoulders beneath hanging chains; their owner/body is not visible. Treat as an unresolved anatomical/contact issue or intentional staging, not accepted continuity.
Finished slab retains etched facial markings and visible gold-colored teeth. The image-left hand is curled and image-right hand open; source-to-slab hand/wardrobe continuity remains unverified.

visual_findings.hands_and_props: Frame 0 shows a plausible ringed hand holding the wineglass bowl/stem region without an obvious extra digit; sampled frames do not establish continuous grip, glass/liquid geometry or ring continuity. Vader's hands rest at the table. Unowned shoulder hands in the chamber require deliberate review.
visible_caveats: Retired brow dice remain, so this is not an approved current identity master
Dinner shot uses leather jacket/open white shirt; chamber and pool shots change to a white fur coat
Ship motif placement, chest markings and metallic teeth need cross-shot consistency review
The frame-120 chamber entry has strong radial blur
Shoulder hands under chains have no visible connected owner in inspected chamber frames
Orange pool and finished carbonite are separate setups with an abrupt cut; transformation continuity is not established

visual_findings.limitations: Review covers 16 evenly spaced frames, four selected full-size frames and eight adjacent cut-boundary frames. No normal-speed playback or audio listening. Lip-sync, actual spoken/sung words, lyric alignment, flicker and continuous hand contact remain unknown.
